gen-gf-goldman-gf-inter-tight: Wide, stout, and sure of itself. Goldman's round forms look like open parentheses, while Inter Tight keeps its curves rope-like and its tails pulled well back.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-karla: Approachable describes Karla's gaping c and stocky middle band, which sit comfortably beneath Goldman's wide, commanding capitals. And the heading's generous letter spacing gives that sturdy body plenty of room to breathe.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri rises with a skyward x-height and rounded letters that stay open and inviting, a friendly counterweight up against the heading. Kedebideri feels roomier at a modest size, while Goldman's wide, bold letters carry the commanding tone.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-khula: Goldman spreads its letters wide with generous clearance, and its round forms look like open parentheses beside the body. Khula answers with a tall, brush-pen belly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-krub: Confident is Goldman, with its big lowercase and wide, parenthesis-like curves, while Krub brings a pronounced x-height and curves left unfinished. They hand off to each other cleanly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-kufam: Wide, bold, and a bit like signage. Goldman's open-parenthesis rounds meet Kufam's single track width, a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, with big bodies and barely-there ascenders.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-lexend: Lexend has outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, with no hairlines or shadows anywhere. But Goldman's wide, commanding capitals give those open forms a firm, confident opening line above them.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-lexend-deca: Goldman's widely set letters and big lowercase give the heading its commanding stance. Lexend Deca stays plain and unshaded, so a slightly larger size lets its small-looking capitals hold up.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-liter: Round forms like open parentheses, spaced wide, mark Goldman out at once. Liter feels quieter and taller in the lowercase, with an unshaded outline that gives the bold heading room to speak.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mada: Mada keeps curves open and its midzone towering. Goldman is the one that commands attention with wide, bold letters, while Mada is the one that settles in and keeps the text approachable.
